description: Resolve DNS records for any domain. Supports A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS. Returns records object with array per type. Default: A records only. Use to verify mail server setup (MX), check domain ownership (TXT), or debug DNS propagation. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"domain":"github.com","types":["A","MX"]}.

types.description: DNS record types to resolve. Default: ["A"]. Supported: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS Lookup
